ana (Docs): quick sync 1: i'm about to push a tiny PR to the Optimize Toolkit page to clarify when to use batching vs kv-prefetch. found two confusing lines and one stale internal link.
raj (Infra): thanks. please make the code examples illustrate the latency vs memory tradeoff, not just the API call. those are what users ask about.
ana (Docs): small correction: it's 'ana' not 'nana' :)
ana (Docs): ah sorry typo above.
ana (Docs): proposed python example: 
```python
# batch-friendly: use BatchGenerate to send multiple short requests together
requests = [ {"prompt": p, "max_tokens": 32} for p in prompts ]
client.batch_generate(requests, prefetch_window=32, enable_kv_prefetch=True)
```
megan (ML): good. please add a short note that kv-prefetch may be skipped for prefixes <8 tokens and that some quant profiles disable fp16 cache behavior. link to the model-compatibility doc.
owen (DevEx): can we include the Go variant too? i can paste our snippet for consistency.
owen (DevEx): go snippet idea: 
```go
reqs := make([]GenerateRequest, len(prompts))
for i,p := range prompts { reqs[i] = GenerateRequest{Prompt: p, MaxTokens:32} }
client.BatchGenerate(ctx, reqs, WithKVPrefetch(32)) // prefetch_window=32
```
kai (QA): i'll run a small perf check on my workstation once examples PR is up. would be great to have a simple script that toggles prefetch on/off.
nana (Docs): i'll add an example script in examples/optkit/perf/ and open two PRs: docs #5301 and examples #5302. the docs PR will fix the links, add py/go snippets, and a short troubleshooting bullet about streaming + batching interactions.
raj (Infra): also mention the prefetch memory cost and that Dedicated customers can tune prefetch_window in their deployment config.
megan (ML): wording suggestion: instead of "avoid aggressive quant", say "for workloads requiring prefix caching, prefer 8-bit or mixed precision; test 4-bit configs with the provided eval set". please include a short one-liner rationale.
owen (DevEx): logging nit: show how to enable client debug to see whether prefetch was applied. sample: ClientConfig{Debug: true} and note log lines.
bot.linkcheck: heads-up: link-check will run on PR #5301 after push.
kai (QA): when you open the examples PR, tag me and i'll run with and without prefetch and paste numbers in the PR. i can also do a quick canary on a small Dedicated pool.
nana (Docs): checklist i'll include in PR description: 1) fix stale internal link 2) add python + go snippets with explicit prefetch_window numbers 3) call out short-prefix threshold (<8 tokens) and mem tradeoffs 4) replace vague quant advice with explicit recommendation + eval link 5) add debugging tip and minimal perf script 6) request reviews from raj/megan/owen/kai.
raj (Infra): ack. if you need a quick review on API names i can glancereview.
megan (ML): i'll review the quant phrasing and the eval link. thanks.
nana (Docs): thanks team, i'll open the PR in ~1h. :rocket:
